thread:
Sasha (CS): Heads up — pre-live enablement checklist for Acme goes live Wed. I drafted a short customer-facing runbook focused on caching, batching, streaming and renewal signals. Sharing for quick review and owners.

Sasha (CS): TL;DR checklist I put in draft:
- Prefill strategy (what to prewarm and when)
- Client-side batching guidance (recommended window + max batch size)
- Streaming vs non-stream fallback (when to degrade)
- Observable signals for renewal risk (usage, latency, errors)
- How to capture feedback post-demo (short survey + NPS link)

Jonah (Solutions): Nice. Add a "what to monitor" section — P95 latency, KV cache hit rate, token cost per session. Include example alert thresholds. :+1:

Priya (SRE): From infra side: ensure warm pools are primed ~30m before demo, prefill top 5 prefixes for the tenant, and set circuit-breaker at 5% 1h error rate. I can add PromQL queries and a runbook snippet.

Marta (PM): Can we map renewal risk to a simple red/yellow/green score? e.g.,
- Green: >50 reqs/day & errors <1%
- Yellow: 10–50 reqs/day or errors 1–3%
- Red: <10 reqs/day or errors >3% sustained 24h
I'll draft the language for the AE handoff.

Sasha (CS): Love the thresholds. Also adding quick remediation steps per bucket and owner assignments.

Jonah (Solutions): Suggest adding this tiny SDK snippet for prefill so customers can reproduce:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill 
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
 -d '{"tenant_id":"acme","prefixes":["billing","account-summary"],"ttl":900}'
```

Priya (SRE): Ops notes: TTL=900s for warm prefixes during demos. If traffic spikes, auto-scale is enabled but fallback policy should shift to a smaller model + non-streaming short responses. Document fallback in runbook.

Sasha (CS): For feedback capture: short 3-question survey link + optional in-app thumbs (thumbs up/down). We should log survey id with tenant id in our CS dashboard.

go-live-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Enablement session with Acme" tomorrow 09:00 — /remind set.

Sasha (CS): Next steps: I'll update the runbook doc and push to docs repo (sashacs/runbooks/acme-prefill). Priya will add PromQL and SLOs, Jonah will add SDK examples, Marta will create renewal note for the AE. Meeting Wed 09:00 confirmed. Anything else?

Marta (PM): Can we add a one-page one-pager for AEs with cut-and-paste remediation steps? I'll draft and share by EOD.

Jonah (Solutions): I can make a short sample alert policy (PagerDuty + Slack) and link it in the runbook.

Sasha (CS): Perfect — posting final doc after lunch. Thanks team :clap:
